utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — sorting donations and pickup coordination are still the big needs. If you can pass that along to nearby neighbors, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass that along to the neighbors nearby. If anything changes on pickup timing, let me know and I’ll help spread the update too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — I will. I’ll let you know right away if the pickup timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so I’ll pass that along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep it quiet and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I appreciate you keeping it quiet and sticking with Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal. I’m writing down the repair drive list now so I don’t forget anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you have the address or time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Not yet, I’m still waiting on that part — I’ll jot it down as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details over shortly, including tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers for small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for the final repair drive details and share them with the neighbors once you send them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m on it, Mara — I’ll send the final repair drive details over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got those marked as covered. What else should I put on the list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep reminding everyone to bring what they can for the repair drive, and I’ll keep sharing the details too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the list updated, and if you hear of anything still missing, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — I heard the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. What do you still need covered?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — we still need a few extra volunteers and someone to help coordinate tools and spare parts. If you can send the repair drive info over, I’ll make sure it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll send the updated repair drive info and help coordinate tools and spare parts. I can also round up a couple more volunteers for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on the repair drive details too, Bo, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what’s left and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — sounds good. Just keep me posted when you hear more.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Bo — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along the repair list and timing as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with whatever still needs covering—just send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey — I’m still missing the address for the repair drive. Where’s it being held again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the address yet—could you send it over when you have it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you need the address, the time, or both for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Both, please — the address and the time would help me a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — send me the address and the time, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Hana — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. We’re still sorting coverage, so any help there would be great.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rosa — what time on Sunday, and can you confirm the community center address? I can help with coverage once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — it’s Sunday at 2 PM at the community center, and I’ll send the exact address right over. Thanks for helping with coverage!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on the full repair drive list and timing so I can work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdriver, and tape over for the repair drive, and I’ll get you the full list and timing so you can fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Gus — send the full list and timing when you have it, and I’ll make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still checking the timing and address on my end. If you can send me the details again, I’ll see whether I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll send you the details and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — that helps. I’m still waiting on the exact time and any pickup details before I can say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you send the address and time? I want to make sure we have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the exact address and time right away so we’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Perfect — please send the exact address and time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still gathering the repair drive details — mostly what items we’re collecting and how the school schedule affects timing. I’ll let you know as soon as I spot anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — please send me the item list and any timing constraints, and I’ll help fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’m checking on the item list and the school timing now, and I’ll send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I’m sending the repair drive details over now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks—I’ll check the screw size and send the full details once I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — appreciate it. I’ll wait for your confirmed details and then we can move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll keep my notes handy so we can stay on track for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Oren — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdriver, and tape over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — that covers the basics nicely. I’ll make sure we’ve got a spot ready for everything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the timing—what time does the repair drive start on Sunday? And if there’s anything else you need dropped off, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the exact Sunday start time over shortly, and I’ll let you know if we still need any extra drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’ll watch for the start time. If anything else comes up, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still waiting on the final address and time, but I’ve got the list and tools on my end. Once Leo sends the details, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — once Leo sends the final address and time, I can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I’ll share the final address and time as soon as Leo sends it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still not sure where it’s being held yet—have you gotten the location details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet—I’ve only heard it’s coming together nicely. If you get the location, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still waiting on the location, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have the address yet—do you know where the repair drive will be held?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the address either. I’ll check and let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina—please let me know as soon as you find the address.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’m still waiting on the repair drive details, and I’ll pass them along as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Once you have the repair drive details, please send them my way and I’ll work from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — as soon as the repair drive details land, I’ll send them your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear anyone who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — appreciate you keeping it low-key. And just so you know, the repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it, thanks — Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need 3 paint cans and a couple more screws if you can find them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for those and bring them by. Anything else you still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — if you can also keep an eye out for a few extra gloves, that’d help too.
